decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the core spraying business, it still has option value and likely modest continuation cost, but its only limited website prominence suggests somewhat higher abandonment risk if demand stays niche.

This product is close to the established offer and already had its own page, so for a medium-sized German machinery firm it is a low-cost, strategically coherent option worth keeping while market feedback develops.

Because it builds on existing pump and material-handling capabilities, the firm would usually keep it on the market another year, though its weaker presentation indicates slightly less commitment than the strongest launches.

Flow monitoring fits the firm's push toward more digitalized and interoperable customer solutions, so despite remaining uncertainty it is a valuable option to retain unless early sales prove clearly disappointing.
